facts.fact: Minister Doumba told WTDC-25 that Gabon has a national fibre backbone of more than 2,000 km, being extended.
Minister Doumba told WTDC-25 that Gabon has four international submarine cables providing its digital opening to the world; landing stations are not named.
The minister states that Ordinance No. 0006/PR of 8 August 2025 requires digitalisation of public administrations and interoperability of their information systems; no enforcing body is named.

facts.fact: The minister says the Centre Gabonais de l'Innovation, an ITU Innovation Alliance member, incubates start-ups and has become a regional driver.
